يصباح (form XI)
# يَصْبَاحُّ (yaṣbāḥḥu) /jasˤ.baːħ.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
# يَصْبَاحَّ (yaṣbāḥḥa) /jasˤ.baːħ.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
# يَصْبَاحِّ (yaṣbāḥḥi) /jasˤ.baːħ.ħi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِصْبَاحَّ (iṣbāḥḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
